name: activating transcription factor 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ATF1 encodes cyclic AMP-dependent transcription factor ATF-1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in cAMP/PKA signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Clear cell odontogenic carcinoma; Clear cell sarcoma of soft tissue; Pulmonary hyalinizing clear cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
